description: Version updates for this repo: images in apps/, and CI. image-mirror/renovate.json is the example for your own deployment repo; this file is for the repo itself.

customManagers.description: kubeconform release used by CI (the checksum next to it has to be updated in the same PR)
Container images run by CI steps (docker run)

packageRules.description: linuxserver.io tags: <app version>[-<build id>]-ls<image revision>. Ignore the build id, compare the version, then the revision.
Major app updates can need config or data migrations: wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard
kubeconform's checksum can't be updated automatically: open these only on request, then add the new SHA-256 by hand
New runner images (ubuntu-XX.04) can break the CI steps: wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard
